title: Vibrant Earthy Japanese Noodles Udon
description: This earthy and adventurous Japanese dish features caramelized onions, ground allspice, and anti-inflammatory-friendly ingredients, all combined with crispy udon noodles.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the udon noodles according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the sesame oil over medium heat and caramelize the onions for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the ground allspice, turmeric, and grated ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and 2 tablespoons of water, then add it to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the shredded daikon to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Drain the cooked udon noodles and add them to the skillet, tossing to combine with the onion and daikon mixture.
Transfer the noodles to a serving platter and sprinkle with chopped scallions and sesame seeds.
Garnish with additional sesame seeds and scallions if desired.
